description: Compiles and runs F0605A (06-05, subprocedures: dcl-proc tax calc, dcl-pr extpgm CALLP against R0409A, QCMDEXC/SNDPGMMSG), F0606A (06-06, string/date BIFs), F0607A (06-07, DS/array %LOOKUP over SHOHIM/ZAIKOM, read-only), F0608A (06-08 'ZAHIK4', likerec/%kds stock allocation over ZAIKOM), and F0609A (06-09, monitor/on-error/on-exit/psds around a deliberate zero-division). Merged from two originally separate batches (05-08 and 09) per advisor review, since both were already compile+run-only with no other reason to spend a separate connection. Per this session's own design revision, F0609A's record-lock demonstration was deliberately moved OUT of the automated pipeline (a real 2-session lock-contention test cannot be reproduced within one verify/ connection) and is left as a 5250x2 manual exercise for the lesson text, same as 06-11b already does - this manifest only exercises F0609A's zero-division/monitor/on-error/psds path. All five report via SNDPGMMSG/QMHSNDPM to the job log (not DSPLY, which needs an interactive job - see each source file's own header), so VFYLOG's automatic job-log dump captures every result with no extra collect step. IMPORTANT SIDE EFFECT: F0605A calls R0409A (ZAHIK3), decrementing the shared ZAIKOM row P00001 (45 -> 43 on a fresh run); F0608A's default run (WRITE/DELETE demo gated off by its own runWriteDeleteDemo indicator, per its header) also does a real CHAIN+UPDATE against ZAIKOM. Both sources' own headers already require TXRESET afterward - this manifest does NOT run TXRESET itself (that is a separate, already-existing tool this manifest assumes the operator runs next, same as 04-09/06-08's own documented requirement), so whoever runs this batch must follow it with TXRESET before relying on ZAIKOM's values again (06-07's own exercise, 06-11b, and 06-15's checkpoint all read ZAIKOM/SHOHIM).
